exposure: Type of lower urinary tract (LUT) injury (full-thickness bladder, ureteral, partial-thickness bladder)
delivery in the first half of the academic year
outcome: Incidence of LUT injury at the time of cesarean delivery
Trends in LUT injury rates over time
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery between 2001 and 2012
finding: Despite an increase in cesarean delivery rates, LUT injury rates remained stable over the study period, with full-thickness bladder injuries being associated with increasing maternal age, transfusion, and active second stage of labor.
mod_finding: This study investigated lower urinary tract injuries during cesarean deliveries.
